items.front: MGNREGA — who is eligible and what is guaranteed?
items.back: Any ADULT member of a rural household; 100 days of unskilled wage employment/year (demand-driven, self-selecting, universal); 1/3 women; unemployment allowance; Gram Sabha social audit. (2005).
items.examPoint: MGNREGA 2005 — legal guarantee of 100 days wage employment

items.front: Which institutions give DIRECT rural credit; what does NABARD do?
items.back: Direct credit: RRBs and Land Development Banks. NABARD (1982) only REFINANCES banks (not direct) and pioneered SHG-Bank Linkage (1992).
items.examPoint: Rural credit institutions — NABARD (refinance) vs RRBs & Land Development Banks (direct credit); cooperatives (PACS/DCCB)

items.front: Lead Bank Scheme & Service Area Approach — link?
items.back: Lead Bank Scheme (1969): each district adopted by a lead bank for intensive credit development. Service Area Approach (1989) operates UNDER the Lead Bank Scheme, assigning villages to branches.
items.examPoint: Lead Bank Scheme (1969) & Service Area Approach (1989) — district credit planning

items.back: Marginal productivity of labour is ZERO — surplus workers (typical of agriculture). Demographic dividend needs skilling, health and jobs to be realised.

items.front: MPI — who compiles it and which dimensions?
items.back: OPHI + UNDP; dimensions = health, education, standard of living (10 indicators) at household level. India has a National MPI (NITI Aayog).
items.examPoint: Multidimensional Poverty Index (OPHI+UNDP) & National MPI (NITI Aayog)

items.front: DILRMP — what does it actually do (and the funding trap)?
items.back: Digitises cadastral maps + transliterates Records of Rights into recognised languages (ULPIN/Bhu-Aadhaar) for conclusive titling. Answer keys treat '100% central funding' as INCORRECT.
items.examPoint: DILRMP (Digital India Land Records Modernisation) — cadastral map digitisation, RoR transliteration, ULPIN/Bhu-Aadhaar

items.back: DAY-NRLM/Aajeevika (2011) = rural women SHG livelihoods + skilling. DAY-NULM = urban counterpart (self-employment, shelters, street vendors with PM SVANidhi 2020).
Population ≥5,000; density ≥400/km²; ≥75% of male working population in non-agricultural work. Urban = statutory towns + census towns. India ~31% urban (2011).
items.examPoint: Urbanisation trends & challenges (slums, migration, solid waste, census criteria)

items.back: Smart Cities Mission (100 cities, area-based+pan-city via SPV); AMRUT (500 towns, water/sewerage); PMAY-Urban (Housing for All, 4 verticals ISSR/CLSS/AHP/BLC); HRIDAY (heritage).
items.examPoint: Smart Cities Mission (2015) — 100 cities, area-based + pan-city, SPV

items.front: SBM — launch, ODF year, SBM 2.0 focus.
items.back: Launched 2 Oct 2014; India declared ODF Oct 2019; SBM 2.0 (2021) targets ODF-Plus (solid/liquid, plastic, greywater). SBM-G under Jal Shakti, SBM-U under MoHUA.
items.examPoint: Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban & Gramin) — sanitation, ODF, ODF-plus

items.back: Rural: SERP (Velugu/Indira Kranthi Patham, built on DWCRA) — women SHG mobilisation. Urban: MEPMA (urban SHGs, DAY-NULM). AP cities Vizag/Kakinada/Tirupati in Smart Cities/AMRUT.
items.examPoint: AP rural initiatives — SERP, DWCRA, Velugu/Indira Kranthi Patham, housing

items.front: RTE, PM POSHAN & District Planning Committees — the inclusive-growth trio.
items.back: RTE Act 2009 (Art 21A): free & compulsory education 6-14. Mid-Day Meal → PM POSHAN (2021): school nutrition + retention. DPCs (Art 243ZD) consolidate panchayat + municipality plans.
items.examPoint: Social-sector convergence — RTE Act (Art 21A), Mid-Day Meal/PM POSHAN, District Planning Committees (Art 243ZD)

items.front: ASHA vs Janani Suraksha Yojana (NRHM) — and poverty-line committees?
items.back: ASHA: village health volunteer — accompanies for ANC/immunisation & counselling, NOT deliveries. JSY: cash transfer for institutional deliveries. Poverty lines: Tendulkar (2009), Rangarajan (2014).
items.examPoint: Maternal-health convergence — ASHA (NRHM) & Janani Suraksha Yojana; poverty-line committees (Tendulkar, Rangarajan)
